 This application coming on for admission this day, the

 Order

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail, who is in jail since 29.09.2023 relating to FIR No.307/2023 registered at Police Station Civil Lines Jabalpur District Jabalpur (M.P.) for the offences under sections 363, 366, 376 (2)(n), 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 5L/6 of the POCSO Act.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 They were consenting party and both of them eloped together.
Later on, offence has been registered against applicant under pressure from family members.
Hence, applicant may be granted bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State as well as counsel for objector opposed the application for grant of bail and submitted that prosecutrix was not a consenting party.
She was taken forcibly by applicant on train and later on, in a resort, she was rapped.
Hence, applicant may not be granted bail.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. Prosecutrix in her statement has stated that she went along with applicant.
On way, she did not ask any help from follow passengers.
Neither made any hue and cry in the resort and after being discovered by police, FIR has been lodged against applicant.
6. Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on merits of the case, bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rs. fifty thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his regular appearance before concerned Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of trial.
8.

The applicant shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C.
C.C. as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE pn Mukul Kumar Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/133153010/
